title: Corruption, wealth, and beauty: The history of the Venetian gondola - Laura Morelli
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】腐敗、財富和美麗：威尼斯貢多拉的歷史 - 勞拉·莫雷利（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: If I say, "Venice," do you imagine yourself gliding down the Grand Canal,
cues.en: If I say, "Venice," do you imagine yourself gliding down the Grand Canal,
cues.zh: 如果我說「威尼斯」 你會不會想到自己在大運河順流而下 聽著船伕唱小夜曲？

cues.text: serenaded by a gondolier?
cues.en: serenaded by a gondolier?
cues.zh: 聽著船伕唱小夜曲？ 毫無疑問，貢多拉 是義大利威尼斯的象徵

cues.text: There's no doubt that the gondola is a symbol of Venice, Italy,
cues.en: There's no doubt that the gondola is a symbol of Venice, Italy,
cues.zh: 毫無疑問，貢多拉 是義大利威尼斯的象徵

cues.text: but how did this curious banana-shaped black boat get its distinctive look?
cues.en: but how did this curious banana-shaped black boat get its distinctive look?
cues.zh: 毫無疑問，貢多拉 是義大利威尼斯的象徵 但是這個奇怪的香蕉形黑船 怎麼演變成這種獨特的外觀？

cues.text: The origins of the Venetian gondola are lost to history,
cues.en: The origins of the Venetian gondola are lost to history,
cues.zh: 威尼斯貢多拉的起源早已失去考據

cues.text: but by the 1500s, some 10,000 gondolas transported dignitaries, merchants and goods
cues.en: but by the 1500s, some 10,000 gondolas transported dignitaries, merchants and goods
cues.zh: 但直至 16 世紀，約一萬艘的 貢多拉載著政要、商賈及貨物 穿流在城市的水道上

cues.text: through the city's canals.
cues.en: through the city's canals.
cues.zh: 穿流在城市的水道上 事實上，威尼斯充滿著 各式各樣的手工船

cues.text: In fact, Venice teemed with many types of handmade boats,
cues.en: In fact, Venice teemed with many types of handmade boats,
cues.zh: 事實上，威尼斯充滿著 各式各樣的手工船 從實用的木筏 到總督御用闊氣的鍍金駁船都有

cues.text: from utilitarian rafts to the Doge's own ostentatious gilded barge.
cues.en: from utilitarian rafts to the Doge's own ostentatious gilded barge.
cues.zh: 從實用的木筏 到總督御用闊氣的鍍金駁船都有 就像現代的計程車系統 船伕租賃貢多拉

cues.text: Like a modern day taxi system, gondolas were leased to boatmen
cues.en: Like a modern day taxi system, gondolas were leased to boatmen
cues.zh: 就像現代的計程車系統 船伕租賃貢多拉 行遍城內的各個渡口

cues.text: who made the rounds of the city's ferry stations.
cues.en: who made the rounds of the city's ferry stations.
cues.zh: 行遍城內的各個渡口 乘客要付一筆船費 從大運河的一邊到另一邊

cues.text: Passengers paid a fare to be carried from one side of the Grand Canal to the other,
cues.en: Passengers paid a fare to be carried from one side of the Grand Canal to the other,
cues.zh: 乘客要付一筆船費 從大運河的一邊到另一邊 或到城內其他地方

cues.text: as well as to other points around the city.
cues.en: as well as to other points around the city.
cues.zh: 乘客要付一筆船費 從大運河的一邊到另一邊 或到城內其他地方

cues.text: But gondoliers soon developed a bad rap.
cues.en: But gondoliers soon developed a bad rap.
cues.zh: 或到城內其他地方 但是船伕很快就搞壞了名聲

cues.text: Historical documents describe numerous infractions involving boatmen, including cursing, gambling, extorting passengers --
cues.en: Historical documents describe numerous infractions involving boatmen, including cursing, gambling, extorting passengers --
cues.zh: 歷史檔案描述了多種 牽涉船伕的違法事件 包括詛咒、賭博、敲詐乘客 甚至偶爾還有暴力事件發生

cues.text: even occasional acts of violence.
cues.en: even occasional acts of violence.
cues.zh: 包括詛咒、賭博、敲詐乘客 甚至偶爾還有暴力事件發生

cues.text: To minimize the unpredictability of canal travel, Venetian citizens who could afford it purchased their own gondolas,
cues.en: To minimize the unpredictability of canal travel, Venetian citizens who could afford it purchased their own gondolas,
cues.zh: 為了減少運河旅行的意外 負擔得起的威尼斯人 都買了自己的貢多拉 就像今天的名流請司機開私家車一樣

cues.text: just as a celebirty might use a private car and driver today.
cues.en: just as a celebirty might use a private car and driver today.
cues.zh: 就像今天的名流請司機開私家車一樣 這些有錢的威尼斯人僱用兩名 私人船伕載著他們在城內穿梭

cues.text: These wealthy Venetians hired two private gondoliers to ferry them around the city
cues.en: These wealthy Venetians hired two private gondoliers to ferry them around the city
cues.zh: 這些有錢的威尼斯人僱用兩名 私人船伕載著他們在城內穿梭 並維修他們的船

cues.text: and maintain their boats.
cues.en: and maintain their boats.
cues.zh: 並維修他們的船 貢多拉很快就成為一種地位的象徵 就像昂貴的汽車

cues.text: The gondolas soon became a status symbol, much like an expensive car,
cues.en: The gondolas soon became a status symbol, much like an expensive car,
cues.zh: 並維修他們的船 貢多拉很快就成為一種地位的象徵 就像昂貴的汽車

cues.text: with custom fittings, carved and gilded ornamentation, and seasonal fabrics, like silk and velvet.
cues.en: with custom fittings, carved and gilded ornamentation, and seasonal fabrics, like silk and velvet.
cues.zh: 有客製化的內裝、精雕及鍍金的裝飾 還有隨季節變換的布料，如絲及絨 然而，今天所見的貢多拉大多是黑色

cues.text: However, the majority of gondolas seen today are black
cues.en: However, the majority of gondolas seen today are black
cues.zh: 然而，今天所見的貢多拉大多是黑色

cues.text: because in 1562, Venetian authorities decreed that all but ceremonial gondolas be painted black
cues.en: because in 1562, Venetian authorities decreed that all but ceremonial gondolas be painted black
cues.zh: 然而，今天所見的貢多拉大多是黑色 因為在 1562 年，威尼斯當局下令 除了慶典用船 所有的貢多拉都要漆成黑色

cues.text: in order to avoid sinfully extravagant displays.
cues.en: in order to avoid sinfully extravagant displays.
cues.zh: 除了慶典用船 所有的貢多拉都要漆成黑色 以避免不道德的過度奢華

cues.text: Apparently, Venetian authorities did not believe in "pimping their rides."
cues.en: Apparently, Venetian authorities did not believe in "pimping their rides."
cues.zh: 以避免不道德的過度奢華 很明顯，威尼斯當局並不相信 「愛船大改造」這玩意！

cues.text: Still, some wealthy Venetians chose to pay the fines in order to maintain their ornamental gondolas,
cues.en: Still, some wealthy Venetians chose to pay the fines in order to maintain their ornamental gondolas,
cues.zh: 很明顯，威尼斯當局並不相信 「愛船大改造」這玩意！ 儘管如此，一些有錢的威尼斯人 還是選擇付罰款 以繼續保有他們華麗的貢多拉 擺門面的小錢哪！

cues.text: a small price to keep up appearances.
cues.en: a small price to keep up appearances.
cues.zh: 擺門面的小錢哪！ 貢多拉特殊的外觀 經過多個世紀演變而來

cues.text: The distinctive look of the gondola developed over many centuries.
cues.en: The distinctive look of the gondola developed over many centuries.
cues.zh: 擺門面的小錢哪！ 貢多拉特殊的外觀 經過多個世紀演變而來

cues.text: Each gondola was constructed in a family boatyard called a squero.
cues.en: Each gondola was constructed in a family boatyard called a squero.
cues.zh: 每一艘貢多拉都由家庭式的 小船廠造出，稱為「斯奎諾」 兒子們從父親和祖父那裡 學到如何選擇及乾燥木料

cues.text: From their fathers and grandfathers, sons learned how to select and season
cues.en: From their fathers and grandfathers, sons learned how to select and season
cues.zh: 兒子們從父親和祖父那裡 學到如何選擇及乾燥木料 如櫸木、櫻木、榆木、杉木、落葉松 椴木、桃木、橡木及胡桃木

cues.text: pieces of beech, cherry, elm, fir, larch, lime, mahogany, oak and walnut.
cues.en: pieces of beech, cherry, elm, fir, larch, lime, mahogany, oak and walnut.
cues.zh: 兒子們從父親和祖父那裡 學到如何選擇及乾燥木料 如櫸木、櫻木、榆木、杉木、落葉松 椴木、桃木、橡木及胡桃木

cues.text: The gondola makers began with a wooden template that may have been hammered into the workshop floor generations earlier.
cues.en: The gondola makers began with a wooden template that may have been hammered into the workshop floor generations earlier.
cues.zh: 貢多拉製造者從一段木頭模板開始 早在幾世代前就已製好 放入車間地板上 從這個基本型 他們再加上船艏及船艉

cues.text: From this basic form, they attached fore and aft sterns,
cues.en: From this basic form, they attached fore and aft sterns,
cues.zh: 從這個基本型 他們再加上船艏及船艉 然後放上縱材肋材組成船身

cues.text: then formed the longitudinal planks and ribs that made up the frame
cues.en: then formed the longitudinal planks and ribs that made up the frame
cues.zh: 然後放上縱材肋材組成船身 專門設計在淺窄的水道上滑行

cues.text: of a boat designed to glide through shallow, narrow canals.
cues.en: of a boat designed to glide through shallow, narrow canals.
cues.zh: 專門設計在淺窄的水道上滑行

cues.text: A gondola has no straight lines or edges.
cues.en: A gondola has no straight lines or edges.
cues.zh: 貢多拉沒有任何直線或尖角 熟悉的船體側面要經由一段 令人驚嘆的水火處理來達成

cues.text: Its familiar profile was achieved through an impressive fire and water process
cues.en: Its familiar profile was achieved through an impressive fire and water process
cues.zh: 熟悉的船體側面要經由一段 令人驚嘆的水火處理來達成 這包括以燃燒的蘆葦火炬翹曲木板

cues.text: that involved warping the boards with torches made of marsh reeds set ablaze.
cues.en: that involved warping the boards with torches made of marsh reeds set ablaze.
cues.zh: 這包括以燃燒的蘆葦火炬翹曲木板 然而，造一艘貢多拉所需的五百小時

cues.text: However, the majority of the 500 hours that went into building a gondola
cues.en: However, the majority of the 500 hours that went into building a gondola
cues.zh: 然而，造一艘貢多拉所需的五百小時 大部分都花在最後一道手續：

cues.text: involved the final stages: preparing surfaces and applying successive coats of waterproof varnish.
cues.en: involved the final stages: preparing surfaces and applying successive coats of waterproof varnish.
cues.zh: 大部分都花在最後一道手續： 表面處理及上幾道防水漆

cues.text: The varnish was a family recipe, as closely guarded as one for risotto
cues.en: The varnish was a family recipe, as closely guarded as one for risotto
cues.zh: 表面處理及上幾道防水漆 防水漆是祖傳秘方 就像義大利燉飯食譜

cues.text: or a homemade sauce.
cues.en: or a homemade sauce.
cues.zh: 防水漆是祖傳秘方 就像義大利燉飯食譜 或自製調醬一樣緊緊保衛著 但即使完成了木工 貢多拉仍然只是半成品

cues.text: Yet even with the woodwork finished, the gondola was still not complete.
cues.en: Yet even with the woodwork finished, the gondola was still not complete.
cues.zh: 但即使完成了木工 貢多拉仍然只是半成品 專業工匠供應製造貢多拉的熟客

cues.text: Specialized artisans supplied their gondola-making colleagues with elaborate covered passenger compartments,
cues.en: Specialized artisans supplied their gondola-making colleagues with elaborate covered passenger compartments,
cues.zh: 專業工匠供應製造貢多拉的熟客 精心製作的船艙 坐墊及鋼飾、銅飾

cues.text: upholstery and ornaments of steel and brass.
cues.en: upholstery and ornaments of steel and brass.
cues.zh: 精心製作的船艙 坐墊及鋼飾、銅飾

cues.text: Oar makers became integral partners to the gondola makers.
cues.en: Oar makers became integral partners to the gondola makers.
cues.zh: 坐墊及鋼飾、銅飾 槳的製造者是貢多拉製造商 不可或缺的夥伴

cues.text: The Venetian oarlock, or fórcola, began as a simple wooden fork,
cues.en: The Venetian oarlock, or fórcola, began as a simple wooden fork,
cues.zh: 槳的製造者是貢多拉製造商 不可或缺的夥伴 威尼斯槳架，或稱「弗考拉」 最初只是一個簡單的木製叉狀物

cues.text: but evolved into a high-precision tool that allowed a gondolier to guide the oar into many positions.
cues.en: but evolved into a high-precision tool that allowed a gondolier to guide the oar into many positions.
cues.zh: 威尼斯槳架，或稱「弗考拉」 最初只是一個簡單的木製叉狀物 但演變成高度精確的工具 讓船伕能操縱船槳到很多位置

cues.text: By the late 1800s, gondola makers began to make the left side of the gondola wider than the right
cues.en: By the late 1800s, gondola makers began to make the left side of the gondola wider than the right
cues.zh: 讓船伕能操縱船槳到很多位置 到十九世紀末期 貢多拉製造者開始將貢多拉左側 做得比右側寬一點 以抵銷單一船伕所產生的力道

cues.text: as a counter balance to the force created by a single gondolier.
cues.en: as a counter balance to the force created by a single gondolier.
cues.zh: 以抵銷單一船伕所產生的力道 這種修正使槳手只需在右側駕船

cues.text: This modification allowed rowers to steer from the right side only,
cues.en: This modification allowed rowers to steer from the right side only,
cues.zh: 這種修正使槳手只需在右側駕船

cues.text: and without lifting the oar from the water.
cues.en: and without lifting the oar from the water.
cues.zh: 這種修正使槳手只需在右側駕船 無需從水中提槳 雖然這樣的修正改進了貢多拉的移動

cues.text: While these modifications improved gondola travel, they were not enough to keep pace with motorized boats.
cues.en: While these modifications improved gondola travel, they were not enough to keep pace with motorized boats.
cues.zh: 雖然這樣的修正改進了貢多拉的移動 它們仍然不敵電動船的速度 今天，只剩約四百艘貢多拉 還在威尼斯的水道上滑行

cues.text: Today, only about 400 gondolas glide through the waterways of Venice,
cues.en: Today, only about 400 gondolas glide through the waterways of Venice,
cues.zh: 今天，只剩約四百艘貢多拉 還在威尼斯的水道上滑行 而正宗的手工貢多拉出產量年年減少

cues.text: and each year, fewer authentic gondolas are turned out by hand.
cues.en: and each year, fewer authentic gondolas are turned out by hand.
cues.zh: 今天，只剩約四百艘貢多拉 還在威尼斯的水道上滑行 而正宗的手工貢多拉出產量年年減少

cues.text: But along the alleys, street signs contain words in Venetian dialect
cues.en: But along the alleys, street signs contain words in Venetian dialect
cues.zh: 而正宗的手工貢多拉出產量年年減少 但在小巷內，寫著威尼斯語的路牌

cues.text: for the locations of old boatyards, oar makers and ferry stations,
cues.en: for the locations of old boatyards, oar makers and ferry stations,
cues.zh: 但在小巷內，寫著威尼斯語的路牌 指示著老船廠、槳製造商 及渡輪站的地點

cues.text: imprinting the memory of the boat-building trades that once kept life in the most serene republic gliding along at a steady clip.
cues.en: imprinting the memory of the boat-building trades that once kept life in the most serene republic gliding along at a steady clip.
cues.zh: 指示著老船廠、槳製造商 及渡輪站的地點 銘刻著造船業曾經何等繁茂 在寧靜的共和國內川流不息的記憶
